topic: Gameplay challenge (EA FC) where each goal conceded triggers a forfeit chosen on a spinning wheel; Argentina v Portugal 'Messi vs Ronaldo' parody
hero: 'Pessie' and Ronaldo-style streamer avatars (parody Messi/Ronaldo characters)
hero_role: players of the challenge, butt of forfeits
hook: EA FC pitch with stadium view, two face-cam streamers top-right (Ronaldo-like and Messi-like), spinner wheel
subtitle_style: none besides on-screen game text and wheel labels (white text on red/blue wheel)
reaction_overlays: face-cam picture-in-picture top-right, spinning forfeit wheel overlay with labels like 'Prank Call Wife', 'Electric shock', 'Get Slapped'
transition_summary: Game cut to wheel full-screen, then back to match; slow cuts (~1 per 10 s) with long gameplay takes
audio_note: commentary/voice banter by two streamers (transcript: 'Can the handsome goat beat Pessie when every time we concede a goal we have to ...')

reuse_segments.how_to_reuse: recreate with own gameplay recording; avoid EA/FIFA assets or use footage cleared under creator terms; replace avatar faces
